name: ALMA prox (Proximal Splitting Adversarial Attack, Rony, Pesquet and Ben Ayed, CVPR 2023)
description: Minimum-norm attack: minimises ||delta||_inf subject to at least adv_threshold of the constrained voxels -- the foreground dilated by constraint_band_mm millimetres -- being misclassified, instead of maximising damage inside a fixed epsilon ball. Augmented Lagrangian on the per-voxel DLR+ constraints (plain logit margin when the model has fewer than three classes), with a proximal step on the non-smooth L-inf norm plus the intensity box, an RMSProp diagonal metric, adaptive constraint scale and decaying constraint masking. Deterministic, so restarts are not run; each reported epsilon keeps the lowest-Dice iterate whose perturbation fits inside it, and the minimal norm itself is the attack's native output.
reference: arXiv:2206.07179, Eqs. 1, 3, 5-8, 17 and Algorithm 1; penalty P2 from arXiv:2011.11857 Eq. 21; reference implementation adv_lib/attacks/segmentation/alma_prox.py
